WITH registration_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.logregistry,
        sr.arcref,
        sr.logaccumm,
        sr.errvalmm,
        sr.logmethod,
        sp.scanresolmm,
        ROUND((sp.scanresolmm / (sr.logaccumm * SQRT(1.0 + sr.errvalmm / sr.logaccumm)))::numeric, 4) AS calculated_ratio
    FROM scanregistration sr
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sr.arcref = sp.arcref AND sr.logregistry = sp.cloudregistry
)
SELECT 
    logregistry AS registration_id,
    arcref AS project_id,
    logaccumm AS accuracy_measurements,
    errvalmm AS error_values,
    calculated_ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN calculated_ratio > 1.5 AND logmethod LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN calculated_ratio BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
FROM registration_data
ORDER BY calculated_ratio DESC;
